Name: Capitalist Dream Farm 2
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b][u][font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4][size=4]features[/size][/color][/font][/u][/b]

[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]crop fields designed to fit iridium sprinklers[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]animal pens with invisible barriers[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]replaces vanilla STANDARD farm[/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]renewable hardwood and foraging area[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]quarry area with stone, ores, etc[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]hot spring pool for energy regeneration (path south of forest exit)[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]private beach with beach forage (right-click boat)[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]upgraded farm cave (optional)[/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]various minecarts and shortcuts for fast travel around the farm[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]compatible with SVE, SVR2, and most recolours[/font]
[/list]
__________________________________________________________________________________________________

[font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u]installation[/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list=1]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url]﻿[/b][b], [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url]﻿[/b],[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/b], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231][b]Farm Type Manager[/b][/url]﻿[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]download this mod and add all the folders to Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]start a new save on the [b]Standard[/b] farm[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]if you want to use a different farmcave mod, open the config.json file and change "EnableFarmCave" from "true" to "false"[/font]
[/list][size=2]
[font=Arial]____________________________________________________________________________________

[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]note: in case any debris or anything spawns in the spa area and you need to remove it manually, there is a shortcut to bypass the waterfall so you don't change into swimwear and therefore aren't able to use tools[/font]

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][spoiler][img]https://i.imgur.com/e4Ksr9v.png[/img][/spoiler][/font]


[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][img]https://i.imgur.com/25X5xsa.png[/img][/font]
[/size]thank u for reading goodbye
